'''Miharr''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Cathar (location)/Legends|Cathar]] of the [[Bounty Supply Company]] stationed on the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire's]] [[Vaiken Spacedock]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and [[Galactic War]] between the Empire and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Miharr appears<ref name="SWTOR" /> in [[BioWare]]'s [[2011]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]]<ref name="Release Date">{{TORweb|url=info/news/press-release/20111220|text=''Star Wars'': The Old Republic Goes Live Today}}</ref> ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as the Bounty Supply reputation vendor.<ref name="SWTOR" />
